title: Mapping Home
logline: A teacher's son from Leka Dulecha grows up learning the map of his land, and becomes the engineer who connects it.
audience: Gemechu's family and Oromo friends at home and in the diaspora, watching on their phones.
intent: Viewers feel pride in where they come from, and see that a teacher's lessons travel forward into his son's work.

voice.name: Kore
voice.style: Speak warmly and unhurriedly, like a son telling his family's story to them

style_block: warm hand-painted illustration, soft golden light, gentle film grain, earthy greens and ochres, calm and dignified mood, subject centred in frame, no text, no letters, no words

gemechu_adult.description: a young Ethiopian Oromo man in his late twenties, short black hair, slim build, light blue button-up shirt

gemechu_child.description: a ten-year-old Ethiopian Oromo boy, short black hair, bright curious eyes, faded white school shirt

father.description: an Ethiopian Oromo man in his fifties, a schoolteacher, short greying hair, kind serious face, simple dark jacket

mother.description: an Ethiopian Oromo woman in her late forties, gentle smile, white cotton dress, light headscarf

cues.description: sparse plucked strings, gentle and hopeful, slow, instrumental
the same theme with soft hand percussion, steady forward motion, instrumental
the opening theme returns warmer and fuller, then resolves softly, instrumental

shots.reason: Establishes home: the hills where everything begins.
shots.image_prompt: rolling green hills of East Wollega at dawn, mist in the valleys, a small round house with a thatched roof, thin smoke rising, eucalyptus trees
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, mist drifting, smoke rising gently, fixed horizon
shots.narration_en: I was born in 1998, in Leka Dulecha, East Wollega.

shots.reason: Introduces the father, the teacher whose lessons shape the film.
shots.image_prompt: a teacher standing at a chalkboard in a simple rural classroom, a chalk outline of a map with no words, morning light through a window
shots.motion_prompt: he turns slightly toward the class, chalk dust in the light, camera static
shots.narration_en: My father, Bulti Firissa, is a teacher of geography and history.

shots.reason: The boy receiving the lesson the whole film is built on.
shots.image_prompt: a boy sitting at an old wooden school desk, chin resting on his hand, listening closely
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in on his face, he blinks and smiles slightly
shots.narration_en: From him, I learned where we come from, and how the world connects.

shots.reason: Introduces the mother and the warmth of home.
shots.image_prompt: a mother by the hearth inside a family home, warm firelight, roasting coffee beans in a flat pan
shots.motion_prompt: smoke curls from the pan, she stirs gently, camera static
shots.narration_en: My mother, Tujube Regasa, [TODO: one thing she did or taught you].

shots.reason: The journey begins: leaving home to study.
shots.image_prompt: a young man with a backpack standing at a university gate, city buildings behind, early morning
shots.motion_prompt: he walks slowly toward the gate, camera tracks gently
shots.narration_en: I went to Addis Ababa to study software engineering.

shots.reason: The motif: the father's map becomes the son's systems.
shots.image_prompt: a young man's face lit softly by a laptop screen at night, the screen facing away from the viewer
shots.motion_prompt: soft screen light flickers on his face, slow push-in
shots.narration_en: My father mapped the land. I learned to map systems.

shots.reason: Where he is now: the work itself.
shots.image_prompt: a young man working with two colleagues in a bright modern office, looking together at a monitor that faces away from the viewer
shots.motion_prompt: he points at the screen and a colleague nods, camera static
shots.narration_en: Today I build banking systems at Cooperative Bank of Oromia.

shots.reason: Why the work matters: it reaches families like his.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of a farmer's weathered hand holding a simple smartphone, green field softly blurred behind, the screen not readable
shots.motion_prompt: thumb taps the phone, shallow depth of field, gentle movement
shots.narration_en: So that families like mine can send money home in seconds.

shots.reason: The emotional core: back home with his parents.
shots.image_prompt: a family coffee ceremony at home, a clay jebena pot and small cups, the son sitting with his father and mother on low stools
shots.motion_prompt: steam rises from the cups, the father laughs softly, camera static
shots.narration_en: [TODO: a saying your father or mother repeats]

shots.reason: Returns to the opening hills to close the circle.
shots.image_prompt: sunset over the same rolling green hills of East Wollega, a young man standing small on a ridge looking out
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-out, warm light fading, grass moving in the wind
shots.narration_en: My father taught the history of our land. I hope to help write its future.
